release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.44.1 promotes the hosted licensing authority to Stable. Production Windows builds now include the Tachyon authority endpoint directly, so members no longer need to configure TACHYON_LICENSE_AUTHORITY_URL manually. Licensing includes automatic first-device claims, signed short-lived entitlements, protected local entitlement storage, remote validation and deactivation, device-limit and revocation handling, and the protected 14-day offline lease. Owner Controls now displays the hosted Tachyon License Authority instead of the legacy GitHub beta registry while authority mode is active and no longer depends on that legacy manifest for its authority view. Licensed launches also keep the authentication screen hidden during startup verification, eliminating the brief authentication-screen flash. This release includes the responsive Classic navigation and Setup Wizard/Chromium release-gate hardening validated in Canary.
